sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the major maintenance 
 procedures P1 of Single stage Horizontal Centrifugal Pump, which must be performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block or at any troubles 
 occurs.

sections.text:
Work
to be Carried Out
Disassembly of the pump:
Be sure the suction and delivery valves are closed.
Open the plug (19) to drain any liquid inside the pump.
Disconnect the motor from foundation and moved it for away the pump.
Pull the pumps coupling by using manual puller.
Take out couplings key (26) from the shaft (10).
Disconnect the cooling water connection (23).

Screw off the nuts (28) to disconnect bearing bracket (5) with lantern
(4) from spiral box (2).

Screw off bolt (27) & (20) to Disconnect foot of bracket (9) from bearing
bracket and foundation.
Take out bearing bracket with lantern from spiral box.
Screws off the nut (14) pull impeller (1) from the shaft.
Take out impellers key (26/1) from shaft (10).
Screw off the nuts (25) and disconnect gland flange (8).
Take out spiral cover (3) from the shaft (10) by hand with turning.
Take out packing and cooling ring (24) from stuffing box.
Pull shaft protection bush (11) from shaft (10).

Take out oil throw ring (13) from shaft (10) and drain oil by open plug
(19).
Screw off bolts (21) to disconnect bearing cover with oil seal.
Screw off safety nut (17).

Hammer the shaft at coupling side by using polyamide hammer. To take out
the shaft with front bearing and without back bearing which will be inside
the bearing bracket.
Pull the front bearing from the shaft by using bearing puller.
Take out back bearing from bearing bracket by hammering.

sections.text: Inspection and renewed of pumps part

Check the impeller (1), packing ring (12) from mechanical wear or
chemical corrosion and renewed if needed.

Check spiral box (2) from pitting or mechanical / chemical wear and
repair it if needed.
Check the shaft protections bush (11) and renewed it if needed.
Check the cooling ring and renewed if needed.
Check the gasket (29) and renewed if needed.
Check the shaft (10) and repair or renewed it if needed.
Check the front and back bearing and renewed it if needed.
Check gasket and oil seal of bearing covers (6) and renewed it if needed.
Check the oil throw rings and renewed it if needed.

sections.text:
Re-alignment of the pump and motor 
According to MPIS doc # cpl-001-r0
Change the packing of the stuffing box
Clean the surfaces of the stuffing box and shaft well.

Wire the suitable packing size on apart of a shaft with same diameter of the 
pumps shaft.
The number of turns equal to number of rings needed.
Cut all packing rings along shaft by using, sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box with cut turned 180 o, starting at 9 
oclock.
The packing should never be knocked as they may become damage .

Remember that in soft packing there must always be as light leakage of fluid 
from gland .

Do not tightened the gland hard to prevent the rise in temperature of 
stuffing box .

Trouble shooting
Trouble | Possible Reasons | Remedy
Pump does not supply any amount | Suction or delivery piping choked | Clean the piping.
High suction head | Decrease the suction head.
Inadequately de-aerated piping. | Re- flood and de-aerated the piping
Pump gives half output or low amount | Pump runs with reverse of rotation | Change the sense of rotation.
Delivery slide valve is closed. | Open the slide valve
Pump doses not deliver required 
 quantity of fuel | Manometric delivery head is higher 
 than it was 
 considered | Set up slide valve on delivery piping for 
 required amount, recheck vapours of the
piping.
Pump low speed. | Measure the speed .
Air cushions are in suction piping. | Align the suction piping and ensure uniform 
 gradient
Pump dose suck in enough | Open fully the slide valve in suction piping.
False suction of air through leakage 
 of the suction 
 piping | Recheck air-tightness of suction piping
Worn of inner parts of the pump 
 (Packing 
 rings , impeller) | Dismantle the pump , exchange worn-off parts
Electric motor is over loaded. | Manometric 
 delivery head is higher than it was considered | Set up slide valve on delivery piping for required amount , recheck vapours 
 of the piping
Pump has low speed. | Measure the speed.
Air cushions are in the suction piping | Level the suction piping and ensure uniform gradient
Pump does not suck in adequately | Open full slide valve on suction piping.
False suction of air through leakage of the 
 suction piping | Recheck air-tightness of suction piping.
Worn of inner parts of the pump
 ( Packing 
 rings , impeller) | Dismantle the pump , exchange worn-off parts.
The pump works with lower delivery head than it was considered by the 
 order | Close slightly the slide valve on delivery 
 piping so that pressure gauge on delivery branch would reach the pressure 
 confirmed by the order.
Specific weight of liquid higher than intended 
 for the pump | Exchange the electric motor with a greater 
 one.
High pressure on delivery branch
 of the pump | High speed | Recheck speed whether they comply with the rating plate data.
Slide valve on delivery piping
 is too closed. | Slide valve on delivery piping would be opened, if it dont help, exchange 
 impeller after agreement with the manufacturing works
Soft gland dose not pack | The gland is loosened. | Tighten the gland.
The gland rings are worn off. | Exchange with new ones.
The pump runs unquietly, the shaft vibrates. | The bearing worn off | Check the bearings, exchange if vibration does not improve, 
 dismantle the 
 pump and measure the rotor.
Unusual and suspicious sounds
 in the pump | Foreign object in spiral, cavitation operation. | Dismantle the pump, put it aside. Increase in flow to the pump, decrease 
 delivery quantity, and check the impeller.
